description: List the sender's documents, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Each row carries declined_by (name, email, reason) when a signer declined — such envelopes have status 'cancelled', but ALWAYS report them to the human as declined, with the reason. Paginate with limit/offset (limit max 100).

status.description: 'declined' is a virtual filter: envelopes voided by a signer's decline (their stored status is 'cancelled')
